description: This header file defines an API for handling temporary files in C, including creation, registration, renaming, deleting, and related operations. It includes struct definitions, function prototypes, inline functions, and detailed documentation comments.

methods.name: create_tempfile_mode
methods.description: Creates a temporary file at the specified path with the given mode, returning a tempfile object or NULL on failure.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * create_tempfile(const char * path)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with default mode 0666 at the specified path.

methods.name: register_tempfile
methods.description: Registers an existing file as a tempfile to be deleted upon program exit.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_sm
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file with a name derived from a template, with optional suffix length and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_s(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen)
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file with specified suffix length, default mode 0600.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_m(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file with specified mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile(const char * filename_template)
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file with default mode 0600.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in a directory derived from a template, with optional suffix length and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_ts(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in a directory, with suffix length, default mode 0600.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_tm(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in a directory, with specified mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_t(const char * filename_template)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in a directory, with default suffix length and mode.

methods.name: xmks_tempfile_m
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a specified mode, possibly with extended behaviors.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * xmks_tempfile(const char * filename_template)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with default mode using extended behavior.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_dt
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a file within it, both scheduled for deletion on program exit.

methods.name: fdopen_tempfile
methods.description: Associates a stdio FILE stream with an open tempfile.

methods.name: int is_tempfile_active(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Checks whether a tempfile object is active (not NULL).

methods.name: get_tempfile_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fp
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer associated with the tempfile.

methods.name: close_tempfile_gently
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor and FILE pointer without deleting the file.

methods.name: reopen_tempfile
methods.description: Reopens a temporary file that has been closed but not yet deleted or renamed.

methods.name: delete_tempfile
methods.description: Closes and deletes the temporary file.

methods.name: rename_tempfile
methods.description: Atomically renames the temporary file to a new path.

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_m
ctags.pattern: /^static inline struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_m(const char *filename_template, int mode)$/

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_tm
ctags.pattern: /^static inline struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_tm(const char *filename_template, int mode)$/
